run.binary_rule: dedicated outcome judgment per call (temperature 0, JSON, evidence-cited); label in {success,fail}; same question the blind annotator answered. NOT derived from the 5 semantic dims; kappa calibrates THIS judgment only — the semantic dims remain uncalibrated diagnostics.

dims.name: language_match
dims.reason: The agent consistently used English and appropriately understood and incorporated the user's code-switched Hindi word "बैंगलोर" into its English response.

dims.name: faithfulness
dims.reason: All agent statements are directly grounded in the information provided by the caller, accurately reflecting the requested date, time, and location for the appointment.

dims.name: repair_quality
dims.reason: The agent acknowledged the partial information provided by the user and asked a single, targeted follow-up question to gather the missing details.

dims.name: conciseness
dims.reason: The agent consistently uses clear and direct language, efficiently progressing the conversation without unnecessary verbosity or repetition.

dims.name: user_frustration
dims.reason: The caller provided information clearly and responded to the agent's clarification request without showing any signs of frustration or needing to repeat themselves.

binary.label: success
binary.reason: The caller's essential goal of booking an appointment was achieved and confirmed by the agent.
